subject: federated-email-join
detail: B ignores email_verified; joining a federated sign-in to a password account by an unverified email would let anyone who controls a provider account claim another person's account
solutions: Join only when the provider says the email is verified; otherwise create a separate account
Never join automatically; require the user to link from a signed-in session
recommended: Join only when email_verified is true; otherwise a separate account (the user's decision)

subject: duplicate-registration
detail: A overwrites an existing account when the same email registers again (account takeover)
solutions: Reject a duplicate email with an error
recommended: Reject duplicates; one account per email

subject: role-change-actor
detail: C's set_role trusts a caller-supplied actor role, does not validate the new role and has no rule against raising your own role
solutions: Resolve the actor from the session token, validate the role, refuse raising your own role
recommended: Actor from session; only admins; role must exist; nobody raises their own role (user decision)
